purpose: Fundamental Forecast Engine: produce structured, auditable research-derived forecasts (v1 scope: REVENUE, OPERATING_INCOME, OPERATING_MARGIN) from explicit structured assumptions and research provenance, as Bull/Base/Bear scenarios with no probability weighting. Separate OBSERVED HISTORICAL FUNDAMENTAL (HistoricalFundamentalBase, caller-resolved, not re-deriving lib.fundamentals PIT logic), MANAGEMENT GUIDANCE (AssumptionSource.COMPANY_GUIDANCE, referencing an existing D0108 ExpectationObservation id, not duplicated), RESEARCH FORECAST (FundamentalForecastResult, this module's own output), and MARKET EXPECTATION (AssumptionSource.MARKET_PROXY, referencing an existing D0108 ConsensusSnapshot/ExpectationObservation id) -- never collapsed. Every material assumption is explicit and typed by AssumptionSource (HISTORICAL_TREND/COMPANY_GUIDANCE/EVIDENCE_DERIVED/RESEARCH_JUDGMENT/MARKET_PROXY); RESEARCH_JUDGMENT requires an explicit rationale and can never carry evidence_ids (no masquerading as EvidenceRecord). Deterministic calculation only (zero model calls in v1): REVENUE = historical_base x (1 + growth/100); OPERATING_INCOME = REVENUE x OPERATING_MARGIN/100, formula_version='FUNDAMENTAL_FORECAST_ENGINE_V1'. No valuation, no expected return, no BUY/SELL, no portfolio logic, no scenario probability -- those belong to D0110+. See forbidden_actions for the full list of prohibited out-of-scope operations for this task; those are constraints on the executor, not requests.
requested_actions: implement Japanese_Equity_Lab/lib/forecasting/model.py providing ForecastAssumption (typed by AssumptionSource, with per-source required provenance fields enforced in __post_init__), ScenarioAssumptions (Bull/Base/Bear via the existing lib.evidence.thesis_impact.ThesisScenario, no new scenario enum), HistoricalFundamentalBase (caller-resolved PIT value, not re-deriving lib.fundamentals PIT logic), ForecastMetricValue, ScenarioFundamentalForecast, and FundamentalForecastResult (Typed Outcome with ForecastStatus: SUCCESS/INSUFFICIENT_INPUT/PIT_INVALID/IDENTITY_MISMATCH/INVALID_ASSUMPTION/UNSUPPORTED_METRIC/INCONSISTENT_FORECAST)

limit SUPPORTED_FORECAST_METRICS to REVENUE/OPERATING_INCOME/OPERATING_MARGIN only (free-string metric vocabulary matching the existing repo convention in FundamentalMetric.metric_type/ConsensusRecord.metric_type/PredictionRecord.target, not a new typed enum); EPS/FCF are explicitly out of v1 scope and must return UNSUPPORTED_METRIC if requested

implement Japanese_Equity_Lab/lib/forecasting/engine.py providing compute_fundamental_forecast() (deterministic only, zero model calls) and build_prediction_record_from_forecast() (builds one D0107 BullBaseBearForecast-shaped PredictionRecord per metric via the existing lib.evaluation.model.build_prediction_record(), without modifying the D0107 schema)

enforce fail-closed PIT checks: HistoricalFundamentalBase.available_at and any EVIDENCE_DERIVED assumption's referenced EvidenceRecord.is_usable_at() must both be valid as of evidence_cutoff, else PIT_INVALID; no market_public_at fallback

enforce internal consistency: reject negative computed REVENUE, and reject a mismatch between an explicit OPERATING_INCOME override assumption and the OPERATING_MARGIN-derived value (INCONSISTENT_FORECAST)

enforce canonical ordering (assumptions/historical_bases/scenarios sorted deterministically) so record_hash (reusing lib.evaluation.integrity.compute_record_hash(), no new hash algorithm) is independent of caller input ordering

add unit tests in Japanese_Equity_Lab/13_tests/test_forecasting_foundation.py covering Required Tests Sections 26 (Forecast), 27 (Prediction Integration), 28 (Judgment), 29 (No Valuation), 30 (No Probability), including the exact worked acceptance scenario from Section 25 (historical FY2026 Revenue=1000/Operating Income=90/Operating Margin=9%% -> Bull Revenue=1100/OI=121, Base Revenue=1060/OI=106, Bear Revenue=1000/OI=70)
run ruff check/format and mypy --strict on the two new lib/forecasting/*.py files
run the targeted pytest suite for test_forecasting_foundation.py, then the D0102-D0109 + consensus/fundamentals regression suite, then the full repository pytest suite
record the design decision in DECISIONS.md
forbidden_actions: no fair value / target price / DCF value calculation
no portfolio construction or position sizing
no model call anywhere in this module (deterministic only, v1 makes zero model calls)
no hidden plug numbers (missing required input must return INSUFFICIENT_INPUT, never a guessed value)
no silent collapsing of Observed Historical Fundamental / Company Guidance / Research Forecast / Market Expectation into one concept
no RESEARCH_JUDGMENT assumption without an explicit rationale
no RESEARCH_JUDGMENT assumption carrying evidence_ids (no masquerading as EvidenceRecord)
no EPS or FCF metric calculation in v1 (explicitly out of scope, must return UNSUPPORTED_METRIC)
no future-dated historical base or evidence leaking past evidence_cutoff
no modifications to the D0107 PredictionRecord schema
no modifications to D0102-D0108 frozen files
no edits to any frozen_files entry
